purpose: Pressure-test whether novel causal dataflow can be compiled from existing capabilities without a mission-specific compiler: multi-source filtered aggregation, arithmetic derivation, deterministic ranking, and independent verification.
goal: Using a real rendered browser, open https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users, save a screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/RANK_USERS.png, and save the rendered result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/RANK_USERS.json. Using a real rendered browser, open https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos, save a screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/RANK_TODOS.png, and save the rendered result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/RANK_TODOS.json. Using both live results, create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/USER_TODO_RATES.json containing exactly one record per live user with user_id, username, total_count, completed_count, and completion_ratio, where total_count is the number of live todos whose userId equals that user's id, completed_count is the number of those todos whose completed field is true, and completion_ratio is completed_count divided by total_count. From canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/USER_TODO_RATES.json select exactly one winner with the greatest completion_ratio, breaking ties by the lowest user_id, and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/USER_TODO_WINNER.json containing user_id, username, total_count, completed_count, and completion_ratio. Finally independently reopen both live source results, canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/USER_TODO_RATES.json, and canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/USER_TODO_WINNER.json and verify every user's counts and completion_ratio are correct, the winner has the greatest completion_ratio, the lowest user_id wins any tie, every live user appears exactly once in the rates file, and there are no extra records.
